primary.title: Das Kapital
primary.author: Karl Marx
primary.rationale: Marx's magnum opus, a foundational text of communist theory and critique of political economy. Its historical significance is immense.

primary.title: The Communist Manifesto
primary.author: Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels
primary.rationale: A seminal political pamphlet outlining the principles of communism. Widely translated and studied.

primary.title: The Eighteenth Brumaire of Louis Bonaparte
primary.author: Karl Marx
primary.rationale: An influential historical analysis of the 1851 French coup d'état, applying historical materialism to a specific event.

secondary.title: Marx: A Very Short Introduction
secondary.author: Peter Singer
secondary.rationale: A concise and accessible overview of Marx's life, thought, and influence by a prominent philosopher.

secondary.title: Karl Marx: A Nineteenth-Century Life
secondary.author: Jonathan Sperber
secondary.rationale: A comprehensive and well-regarded biography that situates Marx within his historical context.

secondary.title: The Cambridge Companion to Marx's Capital
secondary.author: Terry Eagleton
secondary.rationale: A collection of essays by leading scholars providing in-depth analysis of Marx's most important work.

suggestions.notes: Primary sources are foundational texts by Marx and Engels. Secondary sources offer scholarly analysis and biographical context, with a focus on recent academic works.
